payload.content: A weighted base that stays put while you tear sheets one-handed is the detail that makes this Carolina Collection counter top paper towel stand worth a closer look—built from solid brass with a 6.5-inch freestanding footprint to keep the roll upright and space-saving on the kitchen counter. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The felt pad under the base helps prevent scratches on your countertop, and the freestanding design means no drilling or wall mounting required (a practical alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want flexibility). Traditional styling with contemporary touches keeps this brass paper towel holder looking intentional, not utilitarian. Includes the paper towel holder and arrives ready to use with no assembly required, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
